CustomField.description: Optional 18-char Demo_Session__c Id used as the walk-up fallback when a website request carries no `ds` tenant key (single-user demos hitting app.skywave.flights directly). When set to an existing session, Skywave_RestUtil.getActiveDemoSessionId() returns it instead of the most-recently-started active session across ALL presenters — so single-user runs land on a reliable, curated session (e.g. one kept at agent_seat_pass). Blank (or a stale/invalid Id) → the legacy newest-active behavior, so fresh installs and single-tenant orgs are unaffected. Org-specific; set per install, not shipped in source.
CustomField.label: Fallback Demo Session Id
